record.what_it_does: Corporate cards, spend management, expenses and banking platform for businesses.
record.auth_notes: Customer-own-account use: admin-created user token (Bearer, expires after 90 days unused). Multi-user/public integrations: partner OAuth2 authorization code (client credentials for onboarding API) with client ID/secret issued by Brex developer support. MCP server supports OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration.
record.access_notes: A Brex account admin can self-create a user token under Developer > Settings after accepting the API agreement, but that needs a Brex customer account. OAuth client ID/secret for multi-user apps come only through contacting Brex developer support (partner program). Production-only for customer tokens; staging exists for partners.
record.api_breadth_notes: Multiple APIs: Team (users, cards, departments), Transactions, Payments/transfers, Budgets/spend limits, Expenses, Accounting, Onboarding, Webhooks, etc. Exact operation count not confirmed.
record.mcp_notes: https://api.brex.com/mcp (beta; OAuth with DCR; needs admin to accept the developer agreement and enable "Brex in AI assistants" beta).
record.blocker_notes: Multi-user OAuth needs partner credentials from Brex developer support. Per-customer user tokens work without partnership, but only for Brex customers. Staging is partner-oriented, purgeable and has no guarantees. The first-party MCP is beta.

evidence.quote: Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com
The server supports Dynamic Client Registration
The MCP server's tools may change as we continue developing new use cases and features.
data stored in staging environments may be purged at any time
